package governor_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"winkyou/internal/governor"
	"winkyou/internal/probeio"
	"winkyou/internal/v2/loopbackcarrier"
)

type absenceTimeWitness struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	start  time.Time
	points map[string]time.Time
}

func (w *absenceTimeWitness) record(point string, at time.Time) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	if _, exists := w.points[point]; !exists {
		w.points[point] = at
	}
}

func TestLoopbackAbsenceLifecycleWitnessWorker(t *testing.T) {
	count, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WINKYOU_ABSENCE_WITNESS_WORKER_RUNS"))
	if err != nil || count < 1 || count > 1000 {
		t.Fatal("explicit worker count required")
	}
	var current atomic.Pointer[absenceTimeWitness]
	observe := func(point string, at time.Time) {
		if witness := current.Load(); witness != nil {
			witness.record(point, at)
		}
	}
	governor.AbsenceObserverForTest = observe
	probeio.AbsenceObserverForTest = observe
	loopbackcarrier.AbsenceObserverForTest = observe
	trips := 0
	for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
		if !t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("sample_%03d", index+1), func(t *testing.T) {
			stopPressure := absenceWitnessPressure(t)
			defer stopPressure()
			now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
			namespace := t.TempDir()
			if err := governor.PrepareLoopbackCarrierTestNamespace(namespace, now); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			machine, err := governor.AcquireLoopbackCarrierTestGovernor(namespace, "absence-read-only-witness")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			t.Cleanup(func() { _ = machine.Close() })
			local, absent := reserveLoopbackEndpoint(t), reserveLoopbackEndpoint(t)
			bundle, _ := processBundles(t, local, absent, absent, local, repeatedKey(81), now)
			witness := &absenceTimeWitness{points: make(map[string]time.Time)}
			if err := governor.ObserveAbsenceJournalForTest(machine, witness.record); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			current.Store(witness)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			witness.start = time.Now()
			_, connectErr := loopbackcarrier.Connect(ctx, machine, bundle, "absence-read-only-witness", nil)
			witness.record("connect_return", time.Now())
			snapshot := machine.Snapshot()
			if snapshot.ActivePeers != 0 || snapshot.ActiveAttempts != 0 || snapshot.Reserved != (governor.Resources{}) {
				t.Fatal("absence left governor resources")
			}
			if err := machine.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			reopened, err := governor.AcquireLoopbackCarrierTestGovernor(namespace, "absence-reopen-witness")
			var persisted governor.SafetyTripStatus
			if err != nil {
				var rejected *governor.SafetyTripError
				if !errors.As(err, &rejected) {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				persisted = rejected.Status
			} else {
				persisted = reopened.Snapshot().SafetyTrip
				if err := reopened.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			ledger, err := governor.InspectLoopbackCarrierTestLedger(namespace, time.Now())
			if err != nil || ledger.OneHourAdmissions != 1 || ledger.ConsecutiveFailures != 1 {
				t.Fatal("absence journal outcome changed")
			}
			assertReusable(t, local)
			witness.mu.Lock()
			defer witness.mu.Unlock()
			required := []string{"attempt_acquire_begin", "attempt_acquired", "burn_appended", "burn_synced", "presence_deadline", "probeio_started", "tripwire_timer_armed", "presence_cancel_observed", "finish_appended", "finish_synced", "probeio_workers_stopped", "tripwire_timer_stopped", "controller_close_return", "connect_return"}
			for _, name := range required {
				if witness.points[name].IsZero() {
					t.Fatalf("missing monotonic witness: %s", name)
				}
			}
			durations := make(map[string]int64)
			for name, at := range witness.points {
				durations[name] = at.Sub(witness.start).Nanoseconds()
			}
			span := func(a, b string) int64 { return witness.points[b].Sub(witness.points[a]).Nanoseconds() }
			durations["attempt_to_timer_stop_ns"] = span("attempt_acquired", "tripwire_timer_stopped")
			durations["probeio_to_timer_stop_ns"] = span("probeio_started", "tripwire_timer_stopped")
			durations["cancel_observation_lateness_ns"] = span("presence_deadline", "presence_cancel_observed")
			durations["finish_sync_ns"] = span("finish_appended", "finish_synced")
			durations["finish_sync_to_drain_return_ns"] = span("finish_synced", "controller_close_return")
			_, latched := witness.points["persistent_trip_latched"]
			clear := snapshot.SafetyTrip.State == governor.SafetyTripClear && persisted.State == governor.SafetyTripClear && !latched
			if !clear {
				trips++
			}
			report := struct {
				Sample        int              `json:"sample"`
				SafetyClear   bool             `json:"safety_clear"`
				LatchObserved bool             `json:"latch_observed"`
				Times         map[string]int64 `json:"monotonic_ns"`
			}{index + 1, clear, latched, durations}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(report)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			t.Logf("ABSENCE_MEASUREMENT %s", encoded)
			if clear && !errors.Is(connectErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected absence terminal: %v", connectErr)
			}
		}) {
			break
		}
	}
	t.Logf("measurement_requested=%d persistent_trip_samples=%d", count, trips)
	if trips != 0 {
		t.Error("measurement observed a persistent trip; no production repair applied")
	}
}

func absenceWitnessPressure(t *testing.T) func() {
	if os.Getenv("WINKYOU_FLAKE_111_CPU_STRESS") != "1" {
		return func() {}
	}
	workers := runtime.NumCPU() * 2
	stop := make(chan struct{})
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	var checksum atomic.Uint64
	for index := 0; index < workers; index++ {
		wait.Add(1)
		go func(seed uint64) {
			defer wait.Done()
			for {
				select {
				case <-stop:
					return
				default:
				}
				for iteration := 0; iteration < 65536; iteration++ {
					seed = seed*6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
				}
				checksum.Add(seed)
				runtime.Gosched()
			}
		}(uint64(index + 1))
	}
	t.Logf("pressure cores=%d gomaxprocs=%d workers=%d", runtime.NumCPU(), runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), workers)
	var once sync.Once
	return func() { once.Do(func() { close(stop); wait.Wait(); t.Log("pressure_workers_remaining=0") }) }
}
